Argentine Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Argentina comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Argentine documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
PassportRENAPER38000–140000 ARS
Driving Licencethe municipal transit authority25000–95000 ARS
ID CardRENAPER18000–68000 ARS
Green Cardthe Direccion Nacional de Migraciones65000–230000 ARS
Visaan Argentine consulate30000–115000 ARS
Residence Permitthe Direccion Nacional de Migraciones62000–210000 ARS

Two checks specific to Argentina

  • Check the identity document for the RENAPER barcode and confirm the number format.
  • Confirm the passport coat of arms and the machine-readable zone.

Local red flag

  • An identity document with no barcode on the rear.
